definitions.visits: Actual training-mode logits at two different updates, not frozen-model inference or a train/eval contrast
definitions.wrong: anomaly logit < 0 or normal logit >= 0; correct classification does not establish correct AP ranking
definitions.rank: Opposite-class inversion fraction within this full scan, half credit for ties; null if the other class is absent
definitions.material_selection: Existing measured geometry selectors only; old scores and old visit counts are discarded. These profiles do not exhaust all training normal patches.
